hook: Forty thousand EU staff now chat on Matrix.
hookText: The EU Commission moved 40,000 staff to Matrix

beats.say: The European Commission went from a Matrix proof of concept in December 2025 to a tool on every Commission laptop by September 2026.
Built on Matrix by Element and run by the Commission itself, it now serves more than forty thousand users today.
For them, sovereignty meant five things: resilience, vendor diversity, control of data, owning the platform, and leverage in procurement.
